text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
What a magnificent place!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
To think a lottery could bring us to such a wonderful inn...
I should have tried my luck sooner!
choice_data_list: It's not guaranteed to hit, you know.
It's not guaranteed to come true, you know.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I-I know that!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Um, around this area... looks like there are souvenir shops and all sorts of things!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Once we put our bags down,
would you like to go for a short walk?
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's do that!
Yeah, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, just one thing!
There's something I've made up my mind about.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
While we're here,
no talking about training or races!
...How does that sound?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You gotta forget about everything once in a while
and fully refresh yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Things have finally settled down for you too, right?
Now that we've hit a milestone, let's relax from the bottom of our hearts!"
choice_data_list: Did you invite me along just for that?
Did you invite me along just for that?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's part of it too!
However...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, I wanted to be with you.
...Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~♪
Piping hot!
choice_data_list: This is so easy to eat!
It's really easy to eat, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right!
I could gobble this right up!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu,
you almost look like an Umamusume yourself, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: ……Just from eating carrots?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's right, is that bad?
Come on, it sounds fun, so let's think about it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
If you were an Umamusume... you'd be a Pace Setter!
You'd keep a keen eye on your surroundings and gain the upper hand.
choice_data_list: Then let's build the endurance to maintain your top speed.
Then let's build the endurance to maintain your top speed.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Why is that?
choice_data_list: So that not even your closing kick can reach me
So that not even your late-race surge can reach me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Oh! In that case, I'll mark you relentlessly.
That way—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah!
Stop!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't this about racing?
Nope, nope! That's where we stop!
choice_data_list: (Even though I was the one who started it...)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
There's protein!
choice_data_list: Oh, "Onsen Protein"...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: It says the raw ingredients are local specialties from around here, and if you mix it with lukewarm water, it feels just like being in a hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...The nutritional values are pretty great too.
Maybe it's just what I need for a change of pace?
choice_data_list: Should we add that fermented food from there as well?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good, the nutritional balance is perfect too!
Let's add it to the menu simulation—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Wait, again!?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, let's head to the hot springs first after all! If we unwind, I'm sure we can put it out of our minds.
choice_data_list: Alright, shall we do that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Phew~...
choice_data_list: Were you able to take it easy?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes, very much so...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
See? It's a bit more...
relaxed than usual, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That should have completely eased my mind...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—That's right. After our next training session,
let's try using some heating items!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Combining it with a massage might be best.
What I'd like you to do is—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, aaaaah...!
choice_data_list: Now, now, no need to force yourself to forget it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Ugh, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, are you really okay with this?
Even after coming all the way to a place where you could've gotten a proper rest?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Ever since we signed our contract,
I'm all you ever think about, right?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You're my Trainer, but that's not all there is to it.
And yet..."
choice_data_list: Everything.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Uh—
choice_data_list: Because my dream is you yourself.
Because my dream is you yourself.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Keep me reflected in your eyes
fore~ver, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
between Almond Eye and myself...
